name: self-evolving-agent
description: Fixed three-call, read-only economic-agent preflight: retrieve a broad crypto KOL sentiment report, market data for one explicit Hyperliquid asset, and availability/price context for one explicit domain candidate. Every step is paid independently through the SELAT Router; the skill does not create identity, buy infrastructure, fund wallets, or place trades.

asset.description: One Hyperliquid tradable asset ticker, for example BTC or ETH. This is a data-query input, not permission to trade.

domainCandidate.description: Domain candidate to check before any purchase.

steps.label: Broad crypto social context - Otto KOL sentiment
Asset market context - Otto Hyperliquid market
Domain availability and price check - StableDomains
